speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with postpartum fever and abdominal tenderness; have you experienced any vaginal bleeding, foul-smelling discharge, or painful urination since delivery?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for that history. Given the 11-pound delivery and prolonged labor, did you experience any tearing or perineal lacerations during birth, and have you noticed any foul-smelling lochia?

REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC), Urinalysis, and Urine Culture.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum endometritis.
